visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Old Values Remain at the End
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The result for 0 1 0 3 12 should be [1, 3, 12, 0, 0], but the program prints [1, 3, 12, 3, 12].

solution.explanation: Moving the non-zero values forward overwrites the front of the array but leaves the old values behind them. Everything from pos to the end has to be set to 0 explicitly.
